title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [Square buttons](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#Square-buttons)
claim: Avoid using labels to introduce square buttons.** Because square buttons are closely connected with a specific view, their purpose is generally clear without the need for descriptive text.
supporting_text: **Avoid using labels to introduce square buttons.** Because square buttons are closely connected with a specific view, their purpose is generally clear without the need for descriptive text.
